lines.en: label mollynightgen2:
scene mollynightgen2
I show up at the cafe to find Molly slacking off the same way she always does.
lines.zh: 我到咖啡馆时，Molly 正像往常一样在偷懒。

lines.en: Why Haruka continues to allow her to run this place at night is beyond me, but I guess as long as she remains upbeat and energetic, no one is going to complain.
lines.zh: 我不明白 Haruka 为什么一直放心让她在夜里看店，不过我想只要她保持这副元气满满的样子，也没人会抱怨。

lines.en: The only people who show up to coffee shops around this time of night have problems anyway, so it's not like they're coming in here expecting a life-changing experience.
lines.zh: 反正这个点会来咖啡馆的人本身就都有各自的毛病，他们也不是指望着在这里获得什么改变人生的体验。

lines.en: They just want caffeine.
lines.zh: 他们只是想要咖啡因而已。

lines.en: Kind of like how Molly only wants guild members.
lines.zh: 就像 Molly 只想要公会成员一样。

lines.en: I know this because she mentions it probably seven different times over the course of the night.
lines.zh: 我之所以知道，是因为她一整晚大概提了七遍。

lines.en: But, miraculously, I manage to avoid becoming annoyed by it. I think I might even be developing some sort of resistance to her.
lines.zh: 但神奇的是，我竟然没有被这件事惹恼。我觉得自己甚至可能正在对她产生某种抗性。

lines.en: Soon enough, I might even be able to translate her sentences the same way Rin does.
lines.zh: 说不定再过不久，我也能像 Rin 那样翻译她说的话了。

lines.en: One can only hope, I guess.
scene black
Once it comes time for the store to close, Molly begins to say goodbye.
lines.zh: 到了该打烊的时候，Molly 开始跟我道别。

lines.en: But, defying all expectations of me, I offer to help her clean up the store for a little while.
lines.zh: 但出乎所有人（包括她自己）的预料，我提出帮她打扫一会儿店里。

lines.en: She lets out a shockingly loud cry of victory when she realizes this will cut roughly ten minutes off of her closing time and quickly fetches me a broom.
lines.zh: 当她意识到这能让她的打烊时间缩短大约十分钟时，发出了一声大得惊人的欢呼，然后飞快地给我拿来一把扫帚。

lines.en: I sweep for five minutes before realizing I hate this and leave without saying anything.
lines.zh: 我扫了五分钟，意识到自己讨厌干这个，于是一言不发地走了。

lines.en: Sorry, Molly.
This is your fault for trusting me.
lines.zh: 谁让你相信我的，这得怪你自己。
